Acne.notes: SCIN weighted dermatologist label; included with case-level splitting.

Atopic Dermatitis.notes: SCIN has Eczema labels, but they are not equivalent to a separately verified Atopic Dermatitis diagnosis.

Psoriasis.notes: SCIN weighted dermatologist label; retain case grouping and confidence filtering.

Melanoma.notes: Excluded from the final SCIN model because only 3 validated images remain after exact-hash deduplication.

Basal Cell Carcinoma.notes: Excluded from the final SCIN model because only 13 validated images remain after exact-hash deduplication.

Seborrheic Keratosis.notes: The Kaggle folder 'Seborrheic Keratoses and other Benign Tumors' is a mixed category, not a direct Seborrheic Keratosis label.

Rosacea.notes: SCIN weighted dermatologist label; included with case-level splitting.

Vitiligo.notes: The Kaggle candidate's documented class folders do not include Vitiligo.

Warts.notes: Excluded from the final SCIN model because only 46 validated images remain after exact-hash deduplication.

Eczema.notes: Candidate direct folder label from the Kaggle dataset description. Counts require archive inspection.
